content.text: Digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan often face significant barriers when attempting to sell products online due to platform restrictions, including Stripe's limited availability in just 46 countries. This creates a pressing need for real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-what-nobody-tells-7|alternatives]] that not only facilitate transactions but also maintain ownership and control over digital products. This comparison delves into the options available, specifically focusing on Gumroad and Payhip, and highlights how [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-honest-side-side-8|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure can provide a viable solution for creators in restricted regions.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip are popular choices among digital creators, primarily because of their user-friendly interfaces and built-in features for product listing and sales. Gumroad allows creators to sell digital goods with minimal setup, offering features like product delivery, sales tracking, and marketing tools. On the other hand, Payhip is designed for simplicity and offers similar functionalities but focuses more on product pricing flexibility and affiliate marketing. However, these platforms impose geographical restrictions that prevent creators from specific countries from fully leveraging their services. This limitation puts the spotlight on infrastructure alternatives that allow creators to own their sales process without relying on restrictive platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Gumroad and Payhip exclude users from several countries, leaving creators in these regions at a disadvantage. PayPal, often integrated into these platforms, can lock accounts for up to 180 days, freezing funds without appeal, exacerbating the issue for creators. Stripe's global footprint is limited, operating in only 46 countries, which excludes a significant number of potential users from leveraging its services. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, enables creators to set up their online store without facing these geographical barriers. This approach allows for seamless operations regardless of location, breaking the cycle of exclusion from mainstream platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-my-unfiltered-take|COREMERCH guide to payment]] processing, Gumroad and Payhip typically leverage third-party payment processors like PayPal and Stripe, both of which impose fees that can eat into a creator's profits. Gumroad charges a transaction fee that can escalate based on sales volume, while Payhip takes a percentage of each sale. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack utilizes NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with a nominal 0.5% fee. This results in faster payment confirmation times and lower overall costs for creators, making it a more financially sensible option for those in countries with blocked access to traditional payment methods.
Own your sales process outright with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical factor for digital creators. Platforms like Gumroad and Payhip maintain control over user accounts and sales data, making creators reliant on their infrastructure. Once a creator sells a product, they have limited control over the customer relationship and data access. In stark contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack allows creators to maintain complete ownership of their digital products and customer data post-deployment. Additionally, automated delivery processes mean that once a purchase is made, customers receive their products instantly without intervention. This level of control is crucial for creators looking to build their brand and customer loyalty.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you are located in a region where platforms like Gumroad and Payhip are unavailable, the Edge Commerce Stack is clearly the superior choice. It is designed to bypass geographical limitations while providing a robust system for managing sales, payments, and product delivery. Creators can deploy their store in as little as 48 hours and enjoy 30 days of support, allowing for a smooth transition to a self-sufficient sales model. Ultimately, opting for sovereign commerce infrastructure means choosing a future where you are not dependent on external platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Break free from geographical limitations and leverage crypto payments.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
